t: Bellamy's Organic - Wikipedia
s: January 8, 2025 - Established by David Bellamy and Dooley Crighton-Bellamy in northern Tasmania in 2000, Bellamy's was an early entrant into the organic food market, firstly processing and marketing all of Tasmania's organically certified beef, lamb and pork and then producing Australia's first organically certified baby food in 2004, and the first mainstream, supermarket sold, organic baby formula in the world, when it was launched in the Australian market in 2005.
